doc: `Πᵢ Iᵢ` as an ideal of `Πᵢ Rᵢ`.
statement:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {R : ι → Type u_4} → [inst : (i : ι) → Semiring (R i)] → ((i : ι) → Ideal (R i)) → Ideal ((i : ι) → R i)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → Type u_4} [inst : (i : ι) → Semiring (R i)] (I : (i : ι) → Ideal (R i)) (r : (i : ι) → R i),
  r ∈ Ideal.pi I ↔ ∀ (i : ι), r i ∈ I i

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → Type u_4} [inst : (i : ι) → Semiring (R i)] {r : (i : ι) → R i},
  (Ideal.pi fun x => Ideal.span {r x}) = Ideal.span {r}

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → Type u_4} [inst : (i : ι) → Semiring (R i)] {I : (i : ι) → Ideal (R i)}
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {i : ι} {r : R i}, r ∈ I i → Pi.single i r ∈ Ideal.pi I

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → Type u_4} [inst : (i : ι) → Semiring (R i)] {I J : (i : ι) → Ideal (R i)},
  Ideal.pi I ≤ Ideal.pi J ↔ I ≤ J

∀ {α : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) {a b : α} {m n k : ℕ},
  a ^ m ∈ I → b ^ n ∈ I → m + n ≤ k + 1 → Commute a b → (a + b) ^ k ∈ I

∀ {α : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) {a b : α} {m n : ℕ},
  a ^ m ∈ I → b ^ n ∈ I → Commute a b → (a + b) ^ (m + n - 1) ∈ I

∀ {α : Type u_2} {a b : α} [inst : CommSemiring α] (I : Ideal α) {m n k : ℕ},
  a ^ m ∈ I → b ^ n ∈ I → m + n ≤ k + 1 → (a + b) ^ k ∈ I

∀ {α : Type u_2} {a b : α} [inst : CommSemiring α] (I : Ideal α) {m n : ℕ},
  a ^ m ∈ I → b ^ n ∈ I → (a + b) ^ (m + n - 1) ∈ I

∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (s : Multiset α) (n : ℕ),
  s.sum ^ (s.card * n + 1) ∈ Ideal.span ↑(Multiset.map (fun x => x ^ (n + 1)) s).toFinset

∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring α] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α) (n : ℕ),
  (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ (s.card * n + 1) ∈ Ideal.span ((fun i => f i ^ (n + 1)) '' ↑s)

∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring α] (s : Set α),
  Ideal.span s = ⊤ → ∀ (n : ℕ), Ideal.span ((fun x => x ^ n) '' s) = ⊤

∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring α] (s : Set α),
  Ideal.span s = ⊤ → ∀ (n : ↑s → ℕ), Ideal.span (Set.range fun x => ↑x ^ n x) = ⊤

∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring α] {ι : Type u_4} {f : ι → α} {s : Finset ι} (I : Ideal α) {i : ι},
  i ∈ s → f i ∈ I → ∏ i ∈ s, f i ∈ I

∀ {ι : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [Finite ι] (R : ι → Type u_5) [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Semiring (R i)],
  Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => Pi.single i 1) = ⊤

doc:
A bijection between (left) ideals of a division ring and `{0, 1}`, sending `⊥` to `0`
and `⊤` to `1`.
statement: (K : Type u_4) → [inst : DivisionSemiring K] → Ideal K ≃ Fin 2
∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R], ¬IsField R → ∃ x, ∃ (_ : x ≠ 0), ¬IsUnit x
∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R], IsField R ↔ ⊥.IsMaximal
∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R], ¬IsField R → ∃ p, p ≠ ⊥ ∧ p.IsMaximal
∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] {I : Ideal R}, I ≠ ⊥ → I ≠ ⊤ → ¬IsField R
∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R], ¬IsField R ↔ ∃ I, ⊥ < I ∧ I < ⊤
∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R], ¬IsField R ↔ ∃ p, p ≠ ⊥ ∧ p.IsPrime

doc:
Also see `Ideal.isSimpleOrder` for the forward direction as an instance when `R` is a
division (semi)ring.

This result actually holds for all division semirings, but we lack the predicate to state it.
statement: ∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R], IsField R ↔ IsSimpleOrder (Ideal R)

doc: When a ring is not a field, the maximal ideals are nontrivial.
statement: ∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] {M : Ideal R}, M.IsMaximal → ¬IsField R → M ≠ ⊥
∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (M : Ideal R) [hm : M.IsMaximal], ¬IsField R → ⊥ < M
